review_scope: Authored bounded operation artifact and local safety qualification; not independent delivery approval or production execution proof
preconditions: Run as root on the established VPS after normal macro-update has deployed source containing expected merge.
Acquire existing /var/lock/macro-update.lock; no checkout, fetch, source replacement or updater bypass.
Verify committed and working bytes of all 31 critical source pins; reject symlinks/escaped source paths.
Both existing macro-api.service and macro-ticker-news.service active with positive PIDs; installed service files match pins; no pending daemon reload.
Loaded EnvironmentFile order matches reviewed units; writer has no drop-ins; exactly one existing writer process matches its MainPID.
Primary writer provider remains Alpaca with existing primary credentials; supplied licensed credential exists in macro-live.env.
Existing env files and primary receipt are regular root-owned mode0600; existing state and carrier directories are root-owned mode0700.
Optional owned keys are absent, or byte-exact planned state bound to the same recorded operation; no unexplained pre-existing optional state.
API later optional environment file cannot override operation/provider keys.
All three prepared receipt bytes match pinned SHA256 and targets are absent or identical private files.
bounded_effects: Create operation-specific private phase carrier and backups; record intent and preimages before effects.
Install exact already-prepared receipt bytes mode0600 only when absent, using no-clobber atomic installation.
Append only MM_TICKER_NEWS_MASSIVE_ENABLED=1, the exact additional-rights JSON list, and POLYGON_API_KEY to writer env.
Preserve the MASSIVE_API_KEY assignment RHS verbatim from macro-live.env when writing POLYGON_API_KEY; no shell sourcing or secret interpolation.
Append only the same additional-rights JSON list to API env, preserving all other bytes.
Use atomic mode0600 environment writes with stale-preimage detection.
Run existing runner --check-activation with systemd EnvironmentFile parsing and one operation-specific transient unit; no --run or provider request.
Only after exact expected preflight and source-list qualification, restart existing API then the existing sole writer; require PID transitions.
Record applied_awaiting_live_proof; do not claim live publisher coverage from preflight.

runner_payload_assertions.universe_count: integer greater than zero; bool is refused

failure_and_replay: Persist phase and same-carrier readback on failure; no blind rollback or automatic restart of incomplete work.
Repeated completed same-op state produces readback-only no-op after verifying current state.
Incomplete same-op receipt refuses auto-resume and requires parent reconciliation of recorded phase and actual state.
Never print credential values, pass them in argv, source env files, broaden existing permissions, install/arm another writer, or touch DB rows directly.
unproven_until_parent_runtime: Actual deployed ancestry/source and loaded service checks
Actual root-only environment and receipt state
Actual network-dark runner output and exact qualified supplemental sources
Successful API and existing writer restart/readback
Live health, canonical publisher/cluster aggregate visibility, SSE/API and served UI behavior
Generated stock dossier publication through a covering normal render
